accepted.summary: Prohibits grazing on treated fields.
accepted.quote: • Do not graze treated fields.

accepted.summary: Cotton treated with this product must be mechanically harvested.
accepted.quote: • Cotton treated with this product must be mechanically harvested.

accepted.summary: Hand harvesting is prohibited for cotton treated with this product.
accepted.quote: • Hand harvesting is prohibited.

accepted.summary: Restricted-entry interval (REI) of 10 days for fields treated at application rates above 0.75 lb ai/A.
accepted.quote: Do not enter or allow worker entry into treated areas during the restricted-entry interval (REI) of 7 days for fields treated at application rates at or below 0.75 lb ai/A (16 fl oz /A), or 10 days for fields treated at application rates above 0.75 lbs ai/A.

accepted.summary: Restricted-entry interval (REI) of 7 days for fields treated at application rates at or below 0.75 lb ai/A.
accepted.quote: Do not enter or allow worker entry into treated areas during the restricted-entry interval (REI) of 7 days for fields treated at application rates at or below 0.75 lb ai/A (16 fl oz /A), or 10 days for fields treated at application rates above 0.75 lbs ai/A.

accepted.summary: Must apply sufficient spray to ensure uniform leaf wetting.
accepted.quote: Apply sufficient spray to ensure uniform leaf wetting.

accepted.summary: A second application may be made if excessive regrowth occurs between applications and harvest.
accepted.quote: A second application of FOLEX 6 EC will be effective in defoliation of this second growth if excessive regrowth occurs between the first application and first and/or second harvest.

accepted.applies_to: low temperature, low humidity, or plant stress
accepted.summary: Use the higher rate under conditions of low temperature, low humidity, or plant stress.
accepted.quote: Use the higher FOLEX 6 EC rate under conditions of low temperature, low humidity, or plant stress.

accepted.summary: Application requires engineering controls (closed system) for mixing and loading.
accepted.quote: Mixing and loading must be done with engineering controls (closed system).

accepted.summary: Do not use diesel oil when FOLEX 6 EC is used in a tank mixture with other products.
accepted.quote: Do not use diesel oil when FOLEX 6 EC is used in a tank mixture with other products.

accepted.summary: Must not allow pesticide mixtures to dry in spray equipment.
accepted.quote: Do not allow pesticide mixtures to dry in spray equipment.

accepted.summary: Minimum spray volume of 10 gallons per acre required when applied with water.
accepted.quote: A minimum spray volume of 10 gallons per acre is recommended when FOLEX 6 EC is applied with water

accepted.summary: Recommended minimum spray volume of 10 gallons per acre when applied with water.
accepted.quote: A minimum spray volume of 10 gallons per acre is recommended when FOLEX 6 EC is applied with water

accepted.summary: Minimum spray volume of 5 gallons per acre required when applied with diesel oil.
accepted.quote: and a minimum of 5 gallons per acre is recommended when FOLEX 6 EC is applied with diesel oil.

accepted.summary: Recommended minimum spray volume of 5 gallons per acre when applied with diesel oil.
accepted.quote: and a minimum of 5 gallons per acre is recommended when FOLEX 6 EC is applied with diesel oil.

accepted.summary: Release height must not exceed 4 feet above ground or crop canopy.
accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 4 feet above the ground or crop canopy.

accepted.applies_to: ground application near residential areas with low boom
accepted.summary: Buffer of at least 25 feet required from residential areas when using low boom (up to 2 ft height).
accepted.quote: Do not apply within 25 feet of residential areas with a low boom (up to 2 feet above the ground or crop canopy).

accepted.applies_to: ground application near residential areas with high boom
accepted.summary: Buffer of at least 50 feet required from residential areas when using high boom (up to 4 ft height).
accepted.quote: Do not apply within 50 feet of residential areas with a high boom release height (up to 4 feet above the ground or crop canopy).

accepted.summary: Nozzle and pressure must deliver medium or coarser droplets per ASABE S572.
accepted.quote: Applicators must select nozzle and pressure that deliver medium or coarser droplets in accordance with American Society of Agricultural & Biological Engineers Standard 572 (ASABE S572).

accepted.summary: Wind speed must be 10 mph or less at application site.
accepted.quote: For ground rig applications, apply product no more than 4 feet above the ground or the crop canopy and only when wind speed is 10 mph or less at the application site as measured by an anemometer.

accepted.summary: Nozzle and pressure must deliver medium or coarser droplets per ASABE S641.
accepted.quote: Applicators must select nozzle and pressure that deliver medium or coarser droplets in accordance with American Society of Agricultural & Biological Engineers Standard 641 (ASABE S641).

accepted.summary: Release height must not exceed 10 ft above ground or vegetative canopy unless needed for pilot safety.
accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 10 ft above the ground or vegetative canopy, unless a greater application height is necessary for pilot safety.

accepted.summary: Buffer of at least 200 feet required from residential areas for aerial application.
accepted.quote: Do not apply within 200 feet of residential areas.

accepted.summary: Minimum spray volume of 5 gallons per acre recommended when applied with water for aerial application.
accepted.quote: A minimum spray volume of 5 gallons per acre should be used when FOLEX 6 EC and tank mixtures with FOLEX 6 EC are applied with water.

accepted.summary: Minimum spray volume of 3 gallons per acre allowed when using diesel oil for aerial application.
accepted.quote: FOLEX 6 EC alone may be applied in a minimum of 3 gallons of spray volume per acre when using diesel oil

accepted.applies_to: aerial application with diesel oil in California
accepted.summary: Minimum spray volume of 5 gallons per acre required when using diesel oil in California for aerial application.
accepted.quote: (minimum of 5 GPA in California)

accepted.summary: Aerial applicators must be in enclosed cockpits.
accepted.quote: Aerial applicators must be in enclosed cockpits.

accepted.summary: Handlers must limit product handled to 100 gallons per person per day.
accepted.quote: Mixers, loaders, and applicators must limit the amount handled per person to 100 gallons of product per day.

accepted.summary: Do not apply within 200 feet of residential areas.
accepted.quote: Do not apply within 200 feet of residential areas.

accepted.summary: Do not release spray at a height greater than 10 ft above the ground or vegetative canopy, unless a greater application height is necessary for pilot safety.
accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 10 ft above the ground or vegetative canopy, unless a greater application height is necessary for pilot safety.

accepted.summary: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 10 miles per hour at the application site.
accepted.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 10 miles per hour at the application site.

accepted.summary: Do not release spray at a height greater than 4 feet above the ground or crop canopy.
accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 4 feet above the ground or crop canopy.

accepted.summary: Do not apply during temperature inversions.
accepted.quote: Do not apply during temperature inversions.

accepted.applies_to: low boom ground boom applications near residential areas
accepted.summary: Do not apply within 25 feet of residential areas with a low boom (up to 2 feet above the ground or crop canopy).
accepted.quote: Do not apply within 25 feet of residential areas with a low boom (up to 2 feet above the ground or crop canopy).

accepted.applies_to: high boom ground boom applications near residential areas
accepted.summary: Do not apply within 50 feet of residential areas with a high boom release height (up to 4 feet above the ground or crop canopy).
accepted.quote: Do not apply within 50 feet of residential areas with a high boom release height (up to 4 feet above the ground or crop canopy).

accepted.summary: use larger droplets to reduce effects of evaporation
accepted.quote: When making applications in hot and dry conditions, use larger droplets to reduce effects of evaporation.

accepted.summary: avoid application below 2 mph due to variable wind direction and high inversion potential
accepted.quote: Application should be avoided belo w 2 mph due to variable wind direction and high inversion potential.

accepted.summary: Do not exceed 2 ½ pints/A/Year of FOLEX 6 EC for California and Arizona.
accepted.quote: • Do not exceed 2 ½ pints/A/Year of FOLEX 6 EC for California and Arizona, and 1 ½ pints/A/Year for all other states.

accepted.summary: Do not exceed 1 ½ pints/A/Year of FOLEX 6 EC for all other states.
accepted.quote: • Do not exceed 2 ½ pints/A/Year of FOLEX 6 EC for California and Arizona, and 1 ½ pints/A/Year for all other states.

accepted.applies_to: tank mixture of FOLEX 6 EC + thidiazuron
accepted.summary: Apply tank mixture of FOLEX 6 EC + thidiazuron when 60% or more bolls are open for defoliation and inhibition of regrowth.
accepted.quote: Defoliation and inhibition of regrowth is obtained when the tank mixture is applied to mature cotton plants when 60% or more bolls are open.

accepted.applies_to: tank mixture of FOLEX 6 EC + ethephon
accepted.summary: Tank mixture of FOLEX 6 EC + ethephon is recommended for use in all cotton growing states.
accepted.quote: Tank mixture of FOLEX 6 EC + ethephon is recommended for use in all cotton growing states as is applications of FOLEX 6 EC sequential to ethephon.

accepted.applies_to: sequential application of FOLEX 6 EC followed by ethephon
accepted.summary: Applications of FOLEX 6 EC sequential to ethephon are recommended for use in all cotton growing states.
accepted.quote: Tank mixture of FOLEX 6 EC + ethephon is recommended for use in all cotton growing states as is applications of FOLEX 6 EC sequential to ethephon.

accepted.applies_to: tank mixture or sequential application of FOLEX 6 EC + ethephon
accepted.summary: Apply FOLEX 6 EC + ethephon tank mixtures or sequential applications when 30% to 60% of the cotton bolls are open.
accepted.quote: FOLEX 6 EC + ethephon tank mixtures or sequential applications should be applied to cotton when there is sufficient mature unopened bolls to produce the desired yield and when 30% to 60% of the cotton bolls are open.

accepted.applies_to: tank mix activity of FOLEX 6 EC
accepted.summary: Tank mix activity is maximum when the mean 24-hour temperature before and after application is above 60°F.
accepted.quote: • Tank mix activity is maximum when 60% or more bolls are open and the mean 24 -hour temperature before and after application is above 60°F.

accepted.applies_to: tank mix activity of FOLEX 6 EC
accepted.summary: Tank mix activity requires 60% or more bolls open.
accepted.quote: • Tank mix activity is maximum when 60% or more bolls are open and the mean 24 -hour temperature before and after application is above 60°F.

accepted.summary: Use the lower rate of each product when conditions are favorable, for example, high temperatures and high humidity.
accepted.quote: • Use the lower rate of each product when conditions are favorable, for example, high temperatures and high humidity.

accepted.applies_to: application under unfavorable conditions favoring heavy regrowth
accepted.summary: Use the high rate of thidiazuron when environmental conditions favor heavy regrowth.
accepted.quote: • Use the high rate of t hidiazuron when environmental conditions favor heavy regrowth.

accepted.applies_to: tank mixture of FOLEX 6 EC + thidiazuron
accepted.summary: Do not apply FOLEX 6 EC plus thidiazuron to immature cotton (less than 60% bolls open).
accepted.quote: • Do not apply FOLEX  6 EC plus thidiazuron to immature cotton (less than 60% bolls open) or higher than recommended product dosages, as desiccation and leaf freezing may occur.

accepted.applies_to: tank mixture of FOLEX 6 EC + thidiazuron
accepted.summary: Do not apply FOLEX 6 EC plus thidiazuron at higher than recommended product dosages.
accepted.quote: • Do not apply FOLEX  6 EC plus thidiazuron to immature cotton (less than 60% bolls open) or higher than recommended product dosages, as desiccation and leaf freezing may occur.

accepted.summary: Maximum single application rate of FOLEX 6 EC for aerial application is 16 fl oz/A.
accepted.quote: Note: The maximum single application rate of FOLEX 6 EC for aerial application is 16 fl oz/A (0.750 lb  ai/A), and for ground application is 24 fl oz/A (1.125 lb ai/A).

accepted.summary: Maximum single application rate of FOLEX 6 EC for ground application is 24 fl oz/A.
accepted.quote: Note: The maximum single application rate of FOLEX 6 EC for aerial application is 16 fl oz/A (0.750 lb  ai/A), and for ground application is 24 fl oz/A (1.125 lb ai/A).

accepted.applies_to: sequential application following initial application of 16 fl oz or less of FOLEX 6 EC
accepted.summary: Sequential applications may be made 7 days after the initial application when using 16 fl oz or less of FOLEX 6 EC.
accepted.quote: Sequential applications may be made 7 days after the initial application when using 16 fl oz or less of FOLEX 6 EC and 10 days after the initial application when using rates of FOLEX 6 EC greater than 16 fl oz/A.

accepted.applies_to: sequential application following initial application of FOLEX 6 EC greater than 16 fl oz/A
accepted.summary: Sequential applications may be made 10 days after the initial application when using rates of FOLEX 6 EC greater than 16 fl oz/A.
accepted.quote: Sequential applications may be made 7 days after the initial application when using 16 fl oz or less of FOLEX 6 EC and 10 days after the initial application when using rates of FOLEX 6 EC greater than 16 fl oz/A.

accepted.applies_to: REI after applications of 16 fl oz/A or less per application
accepted.summary: REI is 7 days after applications of 16 fl oz/A or less per application (0.75 lb ai/A).
accepted.quote: • REI is 7 days after applications of 16 fl oz/A or less per application (0.75 lb ai/A).

accepted.applies_to: REI after applications of 16 fl oz/A or greater per application
accepted.summary: REI is 10 days after applications of 16 fl oz/A or greater per application (0.75 lb ai/A).
accepted.quote: • REI is 10 days after applications of 16 fl oz/A or greater per application (0.75 lb ai/A).

rejected.summary: When wind speed is 10 mph or less, must use ½ swath displacement upwind at downwind edge.
rejected.quote: If the windspeed is 10 miles per hour or less, applicators must use ½ swath displacement upwind at the downwind edge of the field.

rejected.summary: Boom length must not exceed 65% of wingspan for airplanes.
rejected.quote: The boom length must not exceed 65% of the wingspan for airplanes or 75% of the rotor blade diameter for helicopters.

rejected.summary: Boom length must not exceed 75% of rotor blade diameter for helicopters.
rejected.quote: The boom length must not exceed 65% of the wingspan for airplanes or 75% of the rotor blade diameter for helicopters.

rejected.applies_to: use of FOLEX 6 EC alone instead of tank mix with thidiazuron
rejected.summary: When minimum night temperature is below 60°F, use FOLEX 6 EC alone.
rejected.quote: • When minimum night temperature is below 60°F use FOLEX 6 EC alone.
